archetypes.name: dyn-plr0911-carveout
archetypes.rationale: Verify the PLR0911-only complexity-baseline carve-out stays narrow.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed lint-fix complexity-baseline detection and tests. Check that isolated PLR0911 (new) logs reach the coder waterfall, while metric growth and other complexity codes still fast-fail. Pay close attention to regex matching boundaries and mixed-regression logs. Confirm the shared prompt guidance is visible to all lint-fix tiers without leaking Codex-only instructions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
